signed_rows.behavior: The rule translator turns each apm/.apm/instructions/NAME.instructions.md into rules/NAME.md with front matter trigger: glob and globs: one comma-separated string of the applyTo globs, each starting with **/ (one that already does is kept as is), and the body unchanged; an instruction without applyTo becomes trigger: always_on with no globs.
signed_rows.fails_when: globs is a list, a glob lacks the **/ prefix or gets it twice, the order or set of globs differs from applyTo, the body changes, or a rule without applyTo is not always_on

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl plugin install --harness antigravity writes rules/okf-bundle.md, rules/docs-layout.md, rules/diagrams-stay-current.md and rules/manifesto-invariants.md into .agents/plugins/kmctl/ (from the instructions shipped in the wheel, as _instructions beside _agents), and afterwards no rule file the lock lists for kmctl's package remains under .agents/rules/; any other file in .agents/rules/ is kept; a second install leaves every file the same.
signed_rows.fails_when: a rule is missing from the plugin folder or differs from the translation, a kmctl rule file is left in .agents/rules/, another file there is deleted, the wheel lacks the instructions, or a second install changes a file
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_antigravity.py tests/test_apm_package.py -k "plugin_folder or rules_moved or wheel" -q

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl doctor passes antigravity.files when kmctl's rule files are absent from .agents/rules/ and fails antigravity.plugin, naming the file and kmctl plugin install --harness antigravity, when a rule under .agents/plugins/kmctl/rules/ is missing, edited or extra.
signed_rows.fails_when: antigravity.files fails because kmctl's rules are not in .agents/rules/, or a missing, edited or extra plugin rule goes unreported or names no fix
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_doctor.py -k "antigravity and rule" -q

signed_rows.behavior: With agy on PATH, agy plugin validate --strict --json on the written plugin folder reports no findings and counts the rules; in a scratch consumer installed from a local git server (APM 0.33.0) for antigravity, .agents/rules/ holds none of kmctl's four rules, the plugin folder holds all four, and kmctl doctor exits 0. The validate test skips when agy is absent.
signed_rows.fails_when: validate reports a finding, the install leaves a kmctl rule in .agents/rules/ or lacks one in the plugin folder, or doctor exits nonzero
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_antigravity.py tests/test_doctor.py -m integration -k "validate or consumer" -q

signed_rows.behavior: ADR 0015 (or a decision that amends it) records that kmctl writes the Antigravity rules into its plugin folder and why (APM's list globs, agy's absolute-path matching, the **/ prefix and comma string), and docs/reference/commands.md and the install how-to say the rules for Antigravity live in .agents/plugins/kmctl/rules/.
signed_rows.fails_when: the decision or either page still says APM writes kmctl's Antigravity rules to .agents/rules/, or does not name the plugin folder's rules/
uv run pytest or uv run pytest -m integration fails
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
